correctness.rationale: The simplex-chamber Jacobian is proportional to \((1-nm)^{n-2}\). For symmetric Dirichlet shape one it makes the normalized residual simplex shape independent of its minimum; for every other positive shape the conditional normalized squared-shape expectation has endpoint gap \((n-2)(1-\alpha)/((n-1)\alpha+1)\), nonzero at \(n\ge3\). The exact beta and Dirichlet fourth moments yield the regression/covariance/correlation formulas. The standalone checker passed 1192 exact-rational assertions; it does not stand in for the general proof.

value.rationale: The result gives an iff characterization of the uniform member within a standard one-parameter Dirichlet family using independence of two scalar statistics; it also identifies a minimum-spacing-invariant Greenwood pivot. The full exact conditional calibration after shortest-gap screening is useful for properly combining two natural uniformity diagnostics. The dimension-two failure and nonuniform-shape endpoint obstruction make the structural boundary sharp. This is not simply another marginal Greenwood moment computation.
